answer: A farm as a result forfeits the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. The orchard debit happens at intake, willow totals the burned amount, and lantern anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 26 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. That is 9 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
